tex_content.html:
Lemma
[The inclusion of the regular part is smooth]

↗ prop:regular-level-set-hypersurface ↗ prop:regular-level-set-inclusion-smooth

In the setting of Proposition 5, the inclusion $M_c\hookrightarrow M$ is smooth.

Proof

↗ prop:regular-level-set-inclusion-smooth \sketch Compose the smooth regular-level-set inclusion $M_c\hookrightarrow \mathcal R$ with the smooth open-submanifold inclusion $\mathcal R\hookrightarrow M$.

□
